#compdef mnema
# zsh completion for mnema, generated by `mnema completion zsh`.
#
# For this shell, now:
#     source <(mnema completion zsh)
# For every shell, once:
#     mnema completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_mnema"
#
# It completes verbs, subcommands, option names, and the values of an option whose
# declaration enumerates them, each with what its own help says. It never runs
# mnema to answer a Tab.

_mnema_commands() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo 'init decision link unlink memory observe retract skill stack task promote status brief recall rules rules-file switch inherit verify witness check site search show timeline refs audit diagram export usage resume repl why commits aging trailer commit-hook key tail doctor report completion mcp run before-a-write tally corrections handback help' ;;
    'decision') echo 'record move supersede import help' ;;
    'skill') echo 'create move export provenance help' ;;
    'stack') echo 'add remove list index show diff check export enable disable help' ;;
    'task') echo 'create move handoff next guard help' ;;
    'switch') echo 'off on' ;;
    'inherit') echo 'set update help' ;;
    'witness') echo 'stamp upgrade sigstore' ;;
    'check') echo 'declare run help' ;;
    'audit') echo 'accountability antipatterns exposure help' ;;
    'commit-hook') echo 'install uninstall suggest help' ;;
    'key') echo 'restore request enroll github sigstore revoke protect unprotect help' ;;
    'tail') echo 'list prune help' ;;
    'run') echo 'start end help' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_described() {
  case "$1" in
    '') printf '%s\n' \
      'init:establish a mnema project in the current directory' \
      'decision:record a decision, or move one, in the current project' \
      'link:link one piece of knowledge to another in the current project' \
      'unlink:take a link back, keeping it in the record (only the identity that recorded it; follows the link)' \
      'memory:capture a memory in the current project' \
      'observe:record an observation about an entity in the current project' \
      'retract:take a memory or an observation back, keeping it in the record (follows the note; takes no --scope)' \
      'skill:propose, move or export a reusable skill, or show where each came from' \
      'stack:install a stack of skills and agents into the folders each host reads' \
      'task:create a task, move it, hand it over, or ask what the workflow allows next' \
      'promote:list what recurs across projects, or copy one pattern to the global tree' \
      'status:show where things stand: the work, what governs, what awaits a ruling' \
      'brief:print what governs the work here as markdown, for an agent to read' \
      'recall:print the notes recorded here as markdown, near ones first, for an agent to read' \
      'rules:show which recorded rules govern a path, and which address nothing' \
      'rules-file:print the rules addressed at a file as another host’s rules file, and why the rest are not' \
      'switch:turn off, or back on, what mnema hands to a model unasked, and whether an agent may accept a decision' \
      'inherit:read another repository’s decisions, pinned to one of its commits' \
      'verify:verify this project'\''s record — its committed tree and its private one' \
      'witness:ask an outside witness to date this record, and read where that stands' \
      'check:give a rule a program that checks it, and record whether it held at a commit' \
      'site:write the project'\''s committed record as one HTML page that verifies itself in the browser (records nothing)' \
      'search:find what has been recorded, or list the most recent (no term)' \
      'show:show one whole record by id (the body a search only pointed at)' \
      'timeline:show an entity'\''s history across the trees (subject, about, target)' \
      'refs:show what an entity is connected to across the trees' \
      'audit:ask the record who authorized what, what recurs, and what looks like a credential' \
      'diagram:print a state machine, or an entity’s history or connections, as mermaid' \
      'export:emit the record as an OCSF audit feed (NDJSON, envelope only — never a body)' \
      'usage:what each run cost, read from this machine'\''s Claude Code transcripts' \
      'resume:show where an actor left off, and the runs they still have open' \
      'repl:open an interactive session that reads this project' \
      'why:show under which decisions a file or a commit stands' \
      'commits:show the commits that cite a decision and those that touched what it addresses' \
      'aging:show accepted decisions whose addressed paths changed in many commits since' \
      'trailer:print the commit trailer that ties a commit to a decision' \
      'commit-hook:install or remove an optional git hook that suggests the Mnema-Decision trailer' \
      'key:manage this machine'\''s signing keys' \
      'tail:authorize a cut in the record'\''s own tails' \
      'doctor:say how mnema is installed on this machine, and what to do about each thing found (writes nothing unless you pass --fix)' \
      'report:show, whole, what mnema would say about its own last internal error, and keep your answer to it (sends nothing)' \
      'completion:print the tab-completion script for a shell' \
      'mcp:run the mnema MCP server over stdio (for an agent host)' \
      'run:open and close the session an agent works inside' \
      'before-a-write:answer a host’s hook before a file is written: refuse or ask where a rule says' \
      'tally:answer a host’s Stop or PreCompact hook with what the session wrote and recorded' \
      'corrections:record what a person corrected in a session as proposed decisions, for a Stop hook' \
      'handback:check what a subagent hands back when it stops, or print the format it is checked by' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'decision') printf '%s\n' \
      'record:record a decision in the current project' \
      'move:accept or reject a decision (follows the decision; takes no --scope)' \
      'supersede:supersede a decision with a later one (follows the decision; takes no --scope)' \
      'import:propose the decisions already written in this repository’s decision files' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'skill') printf '%s\n' \
      'create:propose a reusable skill in the current project' \
      'move:move a skill through the workflow (follows the skill; takes no --scope)' \
      'export:write an adopted pattern as the SKILL.md an agent host reads (records nothing)' \
      'provenance:show where each pattern came from (who proposed it, who adopted it)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'stack') printf '%s\n' \
      'add:show the plan of a stack, and write it when --expect names its digest' \
      'remove:remove an installed stack, keeping every file changed since it was written' \
      'list:list the installed stacks, and whether each is still as written' \
      'index:list the stacks an index names, with the digest each must have' \
      'show:show one installed stack: its files, its hooks, and the record' \
      'diff:compare the installed files with their receipt, and the receipt with the record' \
      'check:check every installed stack, or one, against its receipt and the record; fails if any departs' \
      'export:copy an installed stack'\''s skills and agents into a new folder, in a stack'\''s layout' \
      'enable:turn on a hook an installed stack declares: shows its script and asks its name, at a terminal' \
      'disable:turn a hook off again: takes back the approval and the script kept with it' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'task') printf '%s\n' \
      'create:create a task in the current project' \
      'move:move a task through the workflow (follows the task; takes no --scope)' \
      'handoff:record a handoff on a task in the current project' \
      'next:show the moves the workflow allows a task next (records nothing)' \
      'guard:dry-run the gate: would a move be allowed on a task, and if not, why?' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'switch') printf '%s\n' \
      'off:stop a channel handing the record to a model unasked' \
      'on:let a channel hand the record to a model again' ;;
    'inherit') printf '%s\n' \
      'set:point this project at a repository of decisions, at one commit' \
      'update:move the pointer to a newer commit, showing what changes first' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'witness') printf '%s\n' \
      'stamp:ask an outside witness to date each tail'\''s last checkpoint (T3)' \
      'upgrade:go back for every attestation this record is waiting on (T3)' \
      'sigstore:countersign each tail'\''s last checkpoint with a Sigstore certificate — who signed in, and when Rekor logged it' ;;
    'check') printf '%s\n' \
      'declare:declare the program that checks a rule (no shell: the program and its arguments)' \
      'run:run the check of every rule in force and record each result (run by a checker key, in CI)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'audit') printf '%s\n' \
      'accountability:show who authorized what across the record (optionally windowed/filtered)' \
      'antipatterns:show recurring shapes in the record (reopens, supersessions, deprecations)' \
      'exposure:show which records hold something shaped like a credential (never the value)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'commit-hook') printf '%s\n' \
      'install:write the prepare-commit-msg hook in this repository (refuses to replace another one)' \
      'uninstall:remove the prepare-commit-msg hook, only if mnema wrote it' \
      'suggest:what the hook calls: append the suggestion to a commit message file' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'key') printf '%s\n' \
      'restore:restore this machine'\''s identity from a copy of a key'\''s private half' \
      'request:ask to bring this machine into an identity (run this on the joining machine)' \
      'enroll:vouch for a requesting key so it joins this identity (run this on a member)' \
      'github:record that this identity is a GitHub account, so `mnema verify --against-github` can compare the keys that signed with the keys that account publishes' \
      'sigstore:record that this identity is the one a Sigstore certificate names, so a bundle `mnema witness sigstore` files speaks for it in `mnema verify --against-sigstore`' \
      'revoke:retire a key from this identity, from this point forward' \
      'protect:encrypt this machine'\''s private keys at rest with the passphrase in MNEMA_KEY_PASSPHRASE' \
      'unprotect:write this machine'\''s private keys back in the clear (needs MNEMA_KEY_PASSPHRASE)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'tail') printf '%s\n' \
      'list:list the tails that hold events here — the ones a cut can name — with the id `prune` takes' \
      'prune:record that one whole tail was authorized to be cut (it removes nothing)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
    'run') printf '%s\n' \
      'start:open a session for an agent (facts written in it are pinned to it)' \
      'end:close a session (by default the one MNEMA_RUN names)' \
      'help:display help for command' ;;
  esac
}

_mnema_flags() {
  case "$1" in
    '') echo '-V --version --color -h --help' ;;
    'init') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision') echo '--alternatives --scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision record') echo '--alternatives --scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision move') echo '--note -h --help --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision supersede') echo '--reason -h --help --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'decision import') echo '--format --write --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'link') echo '--rel --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'unlink') echo '--rel --reason --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'memory') echo '--scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'observe') echo '--topic --text --scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'retract') echo '--reason --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill') echo '--body --scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill create') echo '--body --scope --which --stdin --body-file -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill move') echo '--note --reason -h --help --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill export') echo '--out --description -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'skill provenance') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack add') echo '--scope --to --as --expect --dry-run -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack remove') echo '--scope --to --dry-run -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack list') echo '--scope --to --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack index') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack show') echo '--scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack diff') echo '--scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack check') echo '--scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack export') echo '--scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack enable') echo '--from --scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'stack disable') echo '--scope --to -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task create') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task move') echo '--reason --note --feedback -h --help --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'task handoff') echo '--scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task next') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'task guard') echo '--actor --reason --note --feedback --json -h --help --which -V --version --color' ;;
    'promote') echo '--workspace --evidence -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'status') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'brief') echo '--hook --host -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'recall') echo '--hook --host -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'rules') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'rules-file') echo '--host -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch off') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'switch on') echo '--reason --scope --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'inherit') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'inherit set') echo '--at --write -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'inherit update') echo '--to --write -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'verify') echo '--global --workspace --allow-no-record --require --since --against-github --against-sigstore --verbose --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'witness') echo '--global --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'witness stamp') echo '--calendar --global -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'witness upgrade') echo '--blocks --global -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'witness sigstore') echo '--global -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'check') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'check declare') echo '--which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'check run') echo '--key --timeout -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'site') echo '--out -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'search') echo '--kind --scope --state --from --to --limit --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'show') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'timeline') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'refs') echo '--direction --depth --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'audit') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'audit accountability') echo '--from --to --who --which --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'audit antipatterns') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'audit exposure') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'diagram') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'export') echo '--from --to --who --which --global -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'usage') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'resume') echo '--actor --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'repl') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'why') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'commits') echo '--json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'aging') echo '--min-commits --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'trailer') echo '--id --json -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'commit-hook') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'commit-hook install') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'commit-hook uninstall') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'commit-hook suggest') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key restore') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key request') echo '--anchor --key --checker -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key enroll') echo '--checker -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key github') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key sigstore') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key revoke') echo '--reason --checker -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key protect') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'key unprotect') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail list') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tail prune') echo '--reason --which -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'doctor') echo '--fix --dry-run -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'report') echo '--decline --off --on -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'completion') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'mcp') echo '--project -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run start') echo '--which --goal -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'run end') echo '--which --outcome -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'before-a-write') echo '--host -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'tally') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'corrections') echo '-h --help -V --version --color' ;;
    'handback') echo '--schema -h --help -V --version --color' ;;
  esac
}

}

_mnema() {
  local prev='' path='' word='' text='' i=2
  local -a described offered
  # Where on the tree the line already is.
  while [ "$i" -lt "$CURRENT" ]; do
    word="${words[$i]}"
    i=$((i + 1))
    case "$word" in
      -*) continue ;;
    esac
    case " $(_mnema_commands "$path") " in
      *" $word "*)
        if [ -z "$path" ]; then path="$word"; else path="$path $word"; fi
        ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ "$CURRENT" -gt 1 ]; then
    prev="${words[$((CURRENT - 1))]}"
  fi
  # A flag whose values the declaration enumerates answers alone.
  text="$(_mnema_values "$path:$prev")"
  if [ -n "$text" ]; then
    compadd -- ${=text}
    return
  fi
  text="$(_mnema_described "$path")"
  if [ -n "$text" ]; then
    described=( ${(f)text} )
    _describe -t commands 'command' described
  fi
  text="$(_mnema_flags "$path") $(_mnema_values "$path:")"
  offered=( ${=text} )
  if [ ${#offered} -gt 0 ]; then
    compadd -- $offered
  fi
}

compdef _mnema mnema
